maddeler.e:
استصبرا (form X)
# اِسْتَصْبَرَا (istaṣbarā) /is.tasˤ.ba.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# اُسْتُصْبِرَا (ustuṣbirā) /us.tusˤ.bi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
# اِسْتَصْبِرَا (istaṣbirā) /is.tasˤ.bi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَصْبَرَ (istaṣbara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
